items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: They had one for Napoleon, and, uh, I believe, I remember, that they had one for Lafayette, too.

ctx.x: What about funeral music in those days? Can you infer anything about it? You come across that?

Well, uh, pre-Civil War days I'm talking about. Pre-Civil War days. The, the, uh, the beginning, sort of, with the great love they had for military funerals here and all that. You see, they had all these veterans of the battle of, uh, January 15th, and there were, uh, uh, 1815, January 8th, 1815, the, the battle of New Orleans. And, uh, uh, uh, uh, even before that battle there was a great, uh, militia tradition here. And almost everyone was organized into this, that, or the other militia company, which loved to…
